about: The past in London, day by day since 2026-11-17: rain measured by the Environment Agency's gauges near central London (the mean across the gauges that reported that day; complete only when each had all 96 quarter-hour readings) and what Open-Meteo forecast one, two and three days before. Temperature is not observed here yet (the Met Office needs a key). Nulls are days we do not have.
